dictionary.controls: FFT grid density and default cutoff
dictionary.why: Accurate avoids wrap-around errors; needed for forces, stress, phonons, elastic.
Stress converges much more slowly than energy, so cell relaxations and elastic runs need the 30% margin to suppress Pulay stress. Keep it identical in every calculation you compare.

dictionary.controls: SCF stop: energy change between electronic steps (eV)
dictionary.typical: 1E-5 relax; 1E-6 SCF/DOS; 1E-7–1E-8 elastic, phonons, optics, ε
dictionary.why: Forces and response properties come from derivatives of the wavefunction, so they need a far tighter SCF than the total energy does. Loose values give noisy forces and imaginary phonon modes.

dictionary.controls: Ionic stop. >0: energy change (eV). <0: max force (eV/Å)
dictionary.why: Negative (force) criteria are more reliable. EDIFF should be at least 10× smaller than any energy-based EDIFFG.

dictionary.controls: Max electronic steps per ionic step
dictionary.why: If a step hits NELM the forces are unconverged; fix mixing first rather than just raising NELM.

dictionary.controls: Min electronic steps per ionic step
dictionary.why: Prevents a too-early exit that yields poor forces.
Lets random wavefunctions settle before the density is updated.
Normal is robust; Fast is quicker for simple systems; All/Damped for magnetic, +U, hybrids, meta-GGA, and stubborn SCF.
0 is safe everywhere. 1 for metal relaxations, never for semiconductors. −5 for accurate DOS and total energies on a uniform mesh with ≥ 4 k-points; not for band paths, not for metal forces.
Check grep EENTRO OUTCAR: the entropy term T·S should be below ~1 meV/atom.

dictionary.typical: 2 for any open-shell d/f system or radical
dictionary.why: A spin-polarized run started with no initial moment can stay non-magnetic; MAGMOM supplies the seed.

dictionary.controls: Initial moment per atom (μB), POSCAR order
dictionary.why: Start above the expected moment (3–5 for 3d ions). Count must equal NIONS (3×NIONS for non-collinear).
Forces a spin state for comparison; remove it for the final ground state.
11 writes lm-decomposed PDOS and PROCAR and site magnetic moments without needing RWIGS.

dictionary.controls: Points on the DOS energy grid
dictionary.why: Default 301 is too coarse for clean PDOS and optical spectra.
Concentrates NEDOS points where you plot.
See restart logic.
11 for band structures and dense-mesh DOS.

dictionary.typical: 2 CG (relax); 6 elastic; not written for SCF (default −1 when NSW = 0)
dictionary.why: 2 far from minimum, 1 close to it. 6 + ISIF≥3 gives elastic constants. 8 gives force constants, ε and Z* by DFPT.

dictionary.controls: What relaxes and whether stress is computed
dictionary.typical: 2 ions; 3 ions+shape+volume; 4 ions+shape at fixed V
dictionary.why: 3 for equilibrium structures, 4 for E–V points, 2 for slabs and defects. ISIF=3 required with IBRION=6 for Cij.
Reaching NSW is not convergence; check for “reached required accuracy”.
Lower it when relaxations oscillate or ZBRENT errors appear.
4 is more accurate (cancels anharmonic error), twice the cost.

dictionary.controls: Projection in real or reciprocal space
dictionary.why: Real-space projection introduces small force/energy errors; use .FALSE. for phonons, elastic, final energies.

dictionary.controls: Extra fine grid for augmentation charges
dictionary.why: Reduces force noise; marginal cost.
Required for meta-GGA; recommended for d/f elements, +U and hybrids.

dictionary.controls: Max l of one-centre densities kept in mixer/CHGCAR
dictionary.why: Default 2 loses d/f occupation information; vital for +U and for ICHARG=11 runs on d/f systems.
Lower AMIX damps charge sloshing in metals, slabs and magnets.
Pair with low AMIX/BMIX for oscillating moments.

dictionary.typical: default; 2–3× for optics; extra for band plots
dictionary.why: Optics needs empty bands for transitions; must exceed occupied bands.
Comment out for IBRION = 6 (elastic), IBRION 7/8, LEPSILON, LELF.
Large speed-up for many k-points; costs memory.

dictionary.typical: .TRUE. for SCF; .FALSE. for band, elastic, phonon displacements
dictionary.why: Saves disk; SCF must write CHGCAR for later ICHARG=11 runs.
Bader needs the all-electron reference density.
Work function and band alignment.
Visualize localization and bonding; use NCORE=1.
Writes ε(ω) to OUTCAR / vasprun.xml.
Smaller sharpens peaks but needs denser k-mesh and NEDOS.

dictionary.controls: DFPT static dielectric tensor, Born charges, piezo tensor
dictionary.why: Insulators only; NCORE=1; not for hybrids (use LCALCEPS).
.FALSE. includes exchange-correlation local fields (the “in DFT” values).

dictionary.controls: ε and Z* by finite electric field
dictionary.why: Works with hybrids and meta-GGA.
Corrects self-interaction in localized d/f states.

dictionary.controls: Per species: l channel (−1 none, 2 d, 3 f), U, J
dictionary.why: One value per species in POSCAR order.
Remove GGA tag. Needs LASPH and τ-capable POTCARs.
Stabilizes meta-GGA SCF.
Hybrid functionals.
AEXX can be tuned to reproduce a known gap; report it if you do.

dictionary.controls: FFT grid for exchange; k-mesh reduction for exchange
dictionary.why: Cut hybrid cost several-fold; check the gap changes by < ~0.05 eV.
Layered, molecular and adsorption systems.
Heavy elements, MAE, topological bands. Needs vasp_ncl and 3 MAGMOM values per atom.

dictionary.typical: default; ISYM = 0 to switch off; SYMPREC 1E-4–1E-3
dictionary.why: Change only to fix symmetry errors or for LOBSTER/defects.

dictionary.controls: Automatic mesh without KPOINTS file (Å⁻¹, includes 2π)
dictionary.why: VASPkit resolution × 2π ≈ KSPACING (0.03 → 0.19).
Asymmetric slabs and adsorption.

errors.cause: Line minimization in CG failed; poor forces or step
errors.fix: cp CONTCAR POSCAR and restart; lower POTIM; tighten EDIFF; IBRION = 1 near minimum

errors.message: Sub-Space-Matrix is not hermitian in DAV
errors.cause: Davidson instability (ALGO = Fast/Normal)
errors.fix: ALGO = All or Normal; change core count/NCORE; check geometry

errors.cause: Ill-conditioned subspace, often bad geometry or random start
errors.fix: ALGO = All / Damped; delete WAVECAR; check interatomic distances; change parallelization

errors.cause: RMM-DIIS failed
errors.fix: ALGO = Normal instead of Fast/VeryFast

errors.cause: Overlap matrix not positive definite; distorted structure or corrupt WAVECAR
errors.fix: Delete WAVECAR; lower POTIM; ALGO = Normal; check POSCAR

errors.cause: Mixer confused, e.g. CHGCAR/WAVECAR from a different structure
errors.fix: Remove old CHGCAR/WAVECAR; restart; adjust AMIX/BMIX

errors.message: VERY BAD NEWS! internal error in subroutine SGRCON
errors.cause: Symmetry detection inconsistent with coordinates
errors.fix: Symmetrize POSCAR; change SYMPREC (1E-4 → 1E-3); ISYM = 0

errors.message: inverse of rotation matrix was not found (increase SYMPREC)
errors.cause: Positions slightly off symmetric sites
errors.fix: SYMPREC = 1E-4 or larger; symmetrize structure

errors.message: PRICEL: found a more primitive cell
errors.cause: Cell is a supercell of a smaller one
errors.fix: Use the primitive cell, or ignore deliberately (supercell intended); ISYM = 0 if it breaks things

errors.message: TOO FEW BANDS / NBANDS too small
errors.cause: Partially filled top band
errors.fix: Increase NBANDS by 20–30%

errors.cause: ISMEAR = −5 set somewhere (e.g. copied INCAR)
errors.fix: ISMEAR = 0, SIGMA = 0.05 as in this workflow

errors.cause: Count does not match NIONS
errors.fix: One value per atom (3 per atom for ncl)

errors.message: The distance between some ions is very small
errors.cause: Overlapping atoms; wrong scale or coordinate type
errors.fix: Check POSCAR line 2, Direct vs Cartesian, duplicate sites from CIF

errors.cause: Real-space projection problem
errors.fix: LREAL = .FALSE.

errors.message: WARNING: CNORMN: search vector ill defined
errors.cause: Ionic step too large or poor SCF
errors.fix: Lower POTIM; tighten EDIFF; switch IBRION

errors.message: ERROR: the number of k-points / bands changed, WAVECAR mismatch
errors.cause: Reading WAVECAR from a different setup
errors.fix: ISTART = 0 or delete WAVECAR

errors.message: LEPSILON / IBRION=7,8 not supported with NCORE/NPAR
errors.cause: Band parallelization in DFPT
errors.fix: Remove NCORE and NPAR

errors.cause: Starting MAGMOM too small, or NM state really lower
errors.fix: Start at 3–5 μB; compare energies; check ISPIN = 2 is set

errors.cause: Loose relax/EDIFF, small supercell, or genuine instability
errors.fix: EDIFF 1E-8, EDIFFG −0.001, ADDGRID, larger DIM; follow eigenvector if persistent

errors.cause: Residual stress, low ENCUT, coarse k-mesh, wrong Voigt mapping
errors.fix: Re-relax at elastic ENCUT; denser k; EDIFF 1E-8; use VASPkit 203 conversion

incarBlocks.name: INCAR
incarBlocks.caption: INCAR · relaxation
incarBlocks.text:
SYSTEM  = Compound-relax
# ---- electronic ----
PREC    = Accurate
ENCUT   = 520          # 1.3 × largest ENMAX (grep ENMAX POTCAR)
EDIFF   = 1E-6         # 1E-7 to 1E-8 when EDIFFG = -0.001
ALGO    = Normal
NELM    = 120
NELMIN  = 6
ISMEAR  = 0            # metals: ISMEAR = 1, SIGMA = 0.1-0.2
SIGMA   = 0.05
LREAL   = .FALSE.      # Auto for cells above ~20 atoms
LASPH   = .TRUE.       # d/f elements
# ---- spin ----
ISPIN   = 2
MAGMOM  = 2*5.0 4*0.6  # one entry per atom, POSCAR order
LMAXMIX = 4            # d elements (6 for f)
# ---- ionic ----
IBRION  = 2            # CG; switch to 1 near the minimum
ISIF    = 3            # ions + cell shape + volume
NSW     = 200
EDIFFG  = -0.005       # max force 0.005 eV/Å; -0.001 for high accuracy
POTIM   = 0.3
# ---- output / parallel ----
LWAVE   = .TRUE.
LCHARG  = .TRUE.
NCORE   = 4

incarBlocks.name: INCAR
incarBlocks.caption: INCAR · SCF (101 → ST, edited)
incarBlocks.text:
SYSTEM  = Compound-scf
ISTART  = 1            # read WAVECAR from the relaxation (same folder)
PREC    = Accurate
ENCUT   = 520          # same 1.3 × ENMAX as the relaxation
EDIFF   = 1E-6         # tighten step by step: 1E-5 → 1E-6 (→ 1E-8 before optics)
ALGO    = Normal
NELM    = 200
ISMEAR  = 0            # VASPkit template value
SIGMA   = 0.05
LREAL   = .FALSE.
ISPIN   = 2
MAGMOM  = 2*5.0 4*0.6
NSW     = 0            # single point; IBRION then defaults to -1
LORBIT  = 11           # projected DOS + PROCAR (for DOS)
NEDOS   = 3001         # fine DOS energy grid
LWAVE   = .TRUE.
LCHARG  = .TRUE.       # CHGCAR is needed for the band step
NCORE   = 4

protocol.title: Relaxation
protocol.yours: “Prepare four INPUT files and changes it as it requires. Run relaxation with encut of 1.3 of Enmax. Ediff, ISPIN, Magmom. INCAR can be prepared from VASPKIT.”

notes.text: ENCUT = 1.3 × ENMAX: the VASP wiki notes the default cutoff often has to be raised by about 30% to converge the stress tensor (Pulay stress). Use the largest ENMAX among your species: grep ENMAX POTCAR.
Force criterion EDIFFG = -0.005 or -0.001 eV/Å. A negative EDIFFG stops when every force is below |EDIFFG| (VASP wiki).
ISPIN = 2 with one MAGMOM value per atom, in POSCAR order. VASPkit: 101 → SR (add MG for spin: SRMG).

protocol.title: SCF in the same folder
protocol.yours: “Same folder RUN SCF calculation. ISTART should be 1, INCAR will be generated from VASPkit. Try Converge repeatedly. For DOS, LORBIT = 11.”

notes.text: ISTART = 1 reads the WAVECAR left by the relaxation (VASP wiki: ISTART).
IBRION is not written. With NSW = 0 VASP’s default is already IBRION = −1 (VASP wiki: IBRION).
ISMEAR = 0, SIGMA = 0.05 as in the VASPkit template. The wiki recommends Gaussian smearing with a small SIGMA for semiconductors and insulators, and warns against the default ISMEAR = 1 for them.
LORBIT = 11 writes the projected DOS and PROCAR. The DOS is read from this SCF run with VASPkit 111 / 113.

protocol.title: Band structure
protocol.yours: “For BAND, Run SCF again without ICHARG=11 in INCAR, then generate KPATH.in which will be KPOINTS vaspkit 3 - 303. For data analyasis, vaspkit 21 211.”

notes.text: The SCF without ICHARG = 11 on a uniform k-mesh writes the converged CHGCAR. 303 writes KPATH.in, which becomes the k-path for the bands, and 211 reads the result.

The VASP wiki says a line-mode k-path “is not suitable for self-consistent calculations”. So the KPATH.in eigenvalues must come from one of two validated routes (details in Band structure): (A) VASP ≥ 6.3: one SCF without ICHARG = 11, with the uniform mesh in KPOINTS and KPATH.in copied to KPOINTS_OPT; (B) a run with KPOINTS = KPATH.in that reads the SCF CHGCAR (ICHARG = 11). This is the INCAR in the VASPKIT band tutorial.

protocol.title: Elastic properties
protocol.yours: “For elastic Properites, Prepare INCAR similar to Relaxation, but IBRION will be 6-8 and ENCUT=620. Comment out NCORE. vaspkit 2 - 203.”

notes.text: The VASP wiki states that IBRION = 6 with ISIF ≥ 3 calculates the elastic constants (six finite lattice distortions, clamped and relaxed ions). Use IBRION = 6, ISIF = 3.
ENCUT = 620: stress needs the higher cutoff, as in step 1.
Comment out NCORE. VASP runs IBRION = 6 without band parallelization (NPAR = number of ranks); NCORE in the INCAR can stop the run.
203 reads TOTAL ELASTIC MODULI from OUTCAR (VASPKIT tutorial).

protocol.title: Optical properties
protocol.yours: “For Optical Properites, run SCF again up to -06 to -08 and then generate INCAR from vaspkit. After SCF calculate get the grep NBANDS OUTCAR. Then take NBANDS 3 times of it with closest ceiling numbers. Add ISPIN and magmom if requires. For data analysis, vaspkit 71 - 711.”

notes.text: VASP wiki (LOPTICS): reasonable results “are usually only obtained if NBANDS is roughly doubled or tripled” with respect to the default. The wiki examples use EDIFF = 1E-8.
“Closest ceiling”: VASP itself increases NBANDS until it is divisible by the number of cores (or by NCORE) (VASP wiki: NBANDS). Round 3 × NBANDS up to that number.
VASPkit: 101 → OP, then 711. Wiki values: CSHIFT = 0.1, NEDOS ≈ 2000.
